description: Search for text snippets from within paper bodies (not just titles and abstracts). Returns matching text passages with section labels and the papers they come from. Useful for finding papers that discuss specific methods, datasets, or concepts in detail.

fields.description: Comma-separated paper fields to include with each snippet. E.g. 'paperId,title,year,authors,url,citationCount'. Default includes paperId, title, year, authors, url.

limit.description: Number of snippet results to return (1-1000, default: 10).

query.description: Text to search for within paper bodies.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable text (default), 'json' for raw structured data

name: snippet_search
